changes.title: Aggro rise
items: Wild animals now take longer to make up their minds when you land among them, reddening as they do, and the screen edges with them, more in a dangerous area; fly off or walk away before they turn fully red and they settle back down

changes.title: Population b8
items: Gentler start: the areas round home hold only a couple of babies and a few animals, and they grow fiercer further along the ley line. About half as many animals on the map as before, more of them grown-ups.

changes.title: Creature shape
items: The game runs smoother with every area full of animals: each step of the rules takes about half the time it did.
